newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish share index closes at new record high.
newsitem.headline: Danish share index closes at new record high.

text.p: Danish share prices closed at a new record high level on Thursday with dealers predicting more gains ahead after the Dow Jones' promising start.
"The good start on Wall Street augurs well for more rises here on Friday in a selective market," one dealer said.

Interest was focused on Tele Danmark, GN Store Nord, Novo Nordisk and Superfos. Tele Danmark closed 10 crowns up at 364 on its streamlining plan, GN Store Nord put on 17 crowns to 665 and Novo Nordisk finished three crowns dearer at 561.
The KFX top-20 index gained 1.21 point to 145.43, hitting a record closing high for the first time since January 15.
Superfos, in focus all day, finished the day 15 crowns up at 785, after its bid for Danish building contractor Phoenix was surpassed by Marius Pedersen.
Overall turnover for the day was 1.491 billion crowns. The KFX March future rose 0.75 point to 144.90 with 90 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
